Berkeley Plantation.question: In 1726, it became the home of the _____ family of Virginia, after Benjamin Harrison IV located there and built one of the first three-story brick mansions in Virginia
Berkeley Plantation.fact: In 1726, it became the home of the Harrison family of Virginia, after Benjamin Harrison IV located there and built one of the first three-story brick mansions in Virginia. It is the ancestral home of two presidents of the United States: William Henry Harrison, who was born there in 1773 and his grandson Benjamin Harrison.
